title: Where can a leg bend?
hook: A hard leg is made of connected parts.

doesNotKnow: Locate the joint in a simplified articulated leg.

misconception: A hard leg must bend through the middle of a rigid segment.
objective: Locate the joint in a simplified articulated leg.

claims.text: A hard leg is made of connected parts. In the simplified insect leg below, which structure lets the two depicted segments change their angle? The picture shows two rigid segments meeting at a joint. Their angle changes at that connection in this simple model; real insect legs contain several segments, joints and muscles.

The precise supporting passages have not been checked.

claims.text: The stage uses a simplified, not-to-scale schematic and stated model assumptions; it is not a photographic observation of an individual animal.
Recall: Two rigid leg segments change angle where they meet. What is that connection? A joint connects the segments and permits relative movement.
